name: vectrix
description: Dependencies for building the Vectrix FFGL plugins. GLEW is only needed on Windows; macOS uses the system OpenGL framework. Audio decoding is dr_libs and stb_vorbis (vendored under external/), plus libogg/libopus/libopusfile built from source as submodules -- deliberately not vcpkg ports, because vcpkg triplets are per-architecture and cannot produce the universal macOS binary.
